title: Crisp Polish Jewelled Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from North Africa. This tagine is made with a mix of juicy polish sausage, sweet jewelled onions and a hint of crisp cilantro.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in the tagine over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the onions, red pepper, and spice mix. Cook until the onions are tender, about 8 minutes.
4. Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
7. Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
